defects.what: Pupil page has 2-3 partial-product slots plus a total slot per item; the key gives only the total (e.g. item 2: 1190, no 1000 / 150 / 40), so partial products cannot be marked (H1).

defects.what: Rounded partial-product slots are about 18 x 7 mm and the total slot about 23 x 7 mm; a 3-4 digit number at 8-10 mm writing height does not fit (H9).
defects.fix: Make rectangles at least 14 mm tall with the slot filling the part, or drop inner boxes and let the pupil write in the empty rectangle; total slot on a 14 mm digit grid.

defects.what: Last pupil page holds 2 items (19-20) in the top 30 %; a 'Maths Quest Pro 9/24/2026' footer sits mid-page and the rest is blank (H5).
defects.fix: Rebalance to full pages (e.g. 18 or 24 items) and keep one footer at the page foot.

defects.what: Three lines of instruction per cell ('Use the model to find...', 'First, find the area of each rectangle.', 'Then, find the total area.') in ~11 pt bold; digits in the model (~10 pt) are smaller than the text.
defects.fix: One instruction line above the grid ('Find each part. Then write the total.'); dimension digits in Andika at the ladder size, the largest thing in the cell.

defects.what: Answer slots are rounded rectangles (card chrome on paper) and differ in width between parts.
defects.fix: Square-cornered boxes of one width per section (standard slot shapes).

defects.what: Rectangles filled teal / orange inside the cell; question text in Nunito (H4).
defects.fix: Paper-white cell, black outlines, one grey; Andika for all cell content.

defects.what: No Check button is visible; the only controls are Hint / Read / Skip, so the pupil cannot see how to submit.
defects.fix: Add the standard Check button beside/below the total slot.

defects.what: The question is repeated below the cell in ~36 px bold ('Use the area model to find 8 x 24') while the model digits are ~22 px; the repeat competes with the item.
defects.fix: Remove the duplicate prompt; dimension and slot digits at 56 px desktop.

defects.what: Hint / Read / Skip are 36 px tall, total input 40 px tall (<44 / <48) (H6).
defects.fix: All targets >= 44 px; digit inputs >= 48 px.

defects.what: Teal / orange / pink fills and Nunito inside the cell (H4).
defects.fix: Black-and-white cell in Andika.

defects.what: No visible Check button.
defects.fix: Add Check.

defects.what: Duplicate prompt below the cell.
defects.fix: Remove it.

defects.what: Part inputs 80x36 and 70x36, Hint/Read/Skip 36 px tall (H6).
defects.fix: Targets >= 44 px, inputs >= 48 px.

defects.what: The area model runs past the right edge of the inner cell (right rectangle touches/cuts the cell border).
defects.fix: Scale the model to the cell width at 390 px or stack parts.

defects.what: Duplicate prompt wraps to three lines of ~40 px bold text and pushes the controls down.
defects.fix: Remove the duplicate prompt.

defects.what: Coloured fills, Nunito in the cell (H4).
defects.fix: Paper-white Andika cell.

defects.what: Two answer slots for the total: the '6 x 247 = [ ]' box inside the model and a full-width 'Answer' input below (H8); pupil does not know which one is marked.
defects.fix: One total slot, inside the model.

defects.what: Teal/orange/pink fills; Nunito and Arial in the cell (H4).
defects.fix: Paper-white Andika cells.

defects.what: One card per full-width row with the model centred in a 1100 px card - six cards need 2000 px of scrolling; model digits ~14 px against the 29 px worksheet size.
defects.fix: Grid of 2-3 equal cards per row with 29 px digits.

defects.what: Skip 61x22 px, speaker 32x27, magnify 28x28, '?' 28x28 crowd the card corners.
defects.fix: Move chrome out of the cell; targets >= 44 px.

defects.what: Instruction is printed twice per card (small italic above, bold repeat below).
defects.fix: One instruction.

defects.what: Total slot inside the model plus a separate 'Type your answer...' box (H8); coloured fills and Nunito in the cell (H4).
defects.fix: One slot set; black-and-white Andika cell.

defects.what: Partial-product boxes look required but the quiz field only takes the total; pupil cannot tell what is scored.
defects.fix: Score the partial boxes or remove them from the quiz render.

defects.what: Prompt repeated under the model.
defects.fix: Remove repeat.

summary: The paper area model has 7 mm rounded slots, a total-only list key that ignores the partial products, and a 2-item last page; screens colour the model and double the total slot.
